title: Localize selector instructions and footer
changes: Use English source keys for cheat detail and filter instructions, and localize the selector item count and selected-item footer while preserving dynamic values and legacy keys.
validation: Offline Linux combined menu/screen build passed all 16 content selector tests, including rendered English/Italian instructions and literal placeholder-containing values. Both language catalogs passed the 513-entry consistency check.
limitations: Native Windows, physical input and a full runtime frontend build were not checked; broader English-first audit remains open.
